description: MUMBAI / PUNE: In a major push toward next-generation digital administration and paperless governance, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on
body_lead: - ‘Maha Indus’ Portal (State Sovereign AI Ecosystem): - Developed as a sovereign artificial intelligence workspace tailored specifically for the Government of Maharashtra. It provides localized, highly secure generative AI frameworks for predictive policy administration, automated summarization, and accelerated citizen service responses, all strictly adhering to Indian data sovereignty norms.
